cases.name: four exact fields load sequentially and retain only the 10.44 MiB sparse CPU representation
source coordinates, layout and capability identity fail closed
oversized or altered metadata stops before any mask request
all four masks preserve nearest-cell CPU picking, byte boundaries and reversible visibility

a corrupt later mask never installs an atlas or fetches later sources
aborting mobile cleanup stops later source requests and cannot publish stale GPU state
mobile controller failure is retryable without reloading its verified atlas, then toggles without network
desktop preparation cannot mistake the four mobile masks for complete local-surface coverage
